Belgian PM says Europe ignored India's trade warnings

Belgian Prime Minister Alexander De Croo stated that Europe ignored India's warnings regarding trade dependencies. He said that India had alerted Europe about the risks of over-reliance on single countries for trade. De Croo indicated that Europe's eyes have now opened to China's trade strategies after experiencing difficulties. He made these remarks in the context of Europe's trade relationships and the need for diversification.
